in_arabic.name: موليد
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم الموليد مشتق من الفعل ولد، و يعني المولود الجديد أو الطفل الذي ولد حديثا. في اللغة العربية، الوليد هو الطفل الذي لم يبلغ بعد، و المولود هو الشخص الذي ولد حديثا. و يعتبر اسم الموليد من الأسماء التي تحمل معنى جميلا و هادئا، و يستخدم في العديد من الثقافات الإسلامية لتعبر عن الفرح و السرور بقدوم المولود الجديد.

in_urdu.name: مولید
in_urdu.meaning: مولید - نیا پیدا ہونے والا، بچہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: مولید نام کا مطلب ہے نیا پیدا ہونے والا یا بچہ۔ یہ نام ولادت سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے پیدا ہونا یا جنم لینا۔ اسلامی ثقافت میں، یہ نام نئے پیدا ہونے والے بچے کے لئے استعمال ہوتا ہے، اور یہ نام فرح و مسرت کا اظہار کرتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: मौलिद
in_hindi.long_meaning: मौलिद नाम का अर्थ है नवजात शिशु या बच्चा। यह नाम अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है, जहां इसका अर्थ है जन्म लेना या पैदा होना। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम नए जन्मे बच्चे के लिए उपयोग किया जाता है, और यह नाम खुशी और आनंद का प्रतीक है।

in_pashto.name: موليد
in_pashto.long_meaning: موليد نوم معنی دے نوی زېږېدلی ماشوم یا ماشوم. دا نوم د ولادت څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې معنی یې ده پیدا کیدل یا زېږېدل. په پښتنه ټولنه کې، دا نوم د نوي زېږېدلي ماشوم لپاره کارول کیږي، او دا د خوښۍ او شادابي څرګندونه کوي.

in_english.long_meaning: Muwallid is an Arabic name that means newborn, infant, or recently born. Etymologically, it is derived from the Arabic root 'wl-d', which means to give birth or to be born. In Islamic tradition, the name Muwallid is used to signify the arrival of a new life and is often associated with joy, happiness, and celebration. Historically, the name has been used across various Muslim cultures to welcome newborns and to express gratitude for the gift of life.

data.cultural_impact: The name Muwallid holds great significance in Islamic culture as it reflects the special bond between Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) and his mother, Amina. This name is a reminder of the crucial role played by Amina in the birth and life of the Prophet, who is considered the last messenger of Allah (God) to humanity. Furthermore, the name highlights the importance of maternal love and care in nurturing and raising a prophet, showing how Allah uses all human relationships and experiences to shape the messengers of His will.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Muwallid highlights the fact that both the mother (Amina) and Allah played essential roles in the Prophet's life and development. The name inspires gratitude for the blessings of creation and growth and serves as a reminder to cherish and honor the bond between a mother and her child. Additionally, the name points to the interconnectedness of the physical and spiritual worlds since both the biological and divine aspects of the Prophet's conception and birth contributed to his unique destiny.

historical_references.reference: Muwallid bin Shibl was a prominent companion of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) and one of the ten who were given the glad tidings of entering Paradise. He was known for his generosity and would feed the poor and needy in Medina. His name 'Muwallid' means 'the one who unites' and was given this name because he would bring together families and communities during the annual Hajj pilgrimage.

During the Umayyad Caliphate, Muwallad ibn Abi Marthad al-Zuhri became a prominent scholar of Islamic jurisprudence, born in Medina. He was a student of Ibn Abbas and Ibn Umar, and his works include 'Al-Muharrar fi Hadith al-Mawquf bil-Arabiyah', a collection of hadiths. Muwallid's name was also 'Muwallid' because of his ability to bring together various pieces of knowledge and transmit them accurately.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name 'Muwallid' refers to the Islamic scholar and historian from the 8th century. He is known for his extensive work on genealogy and biographical information of Prophet Muhammad and his companions. In modern context, this name is often used in discussions related to Islamic culture, Arabic heritage, and historical figures on various platforms such as Twitter, Instagram, and Reddit. On Twitter, users often share quotes from Muwallid's works or engage in debates about his research. Instagram users may post images of historical sites or figures related to Muwallid, while Reddit users may participate in discussions about Islamic history and Muwallid's contributions to it. Overall, the name 'Muwallid' has seen a resurgence in popularity in online Islamic communities as a symbol of historical knowledge and scholarly research.
